# PowerLink v1.0.0 — Home Assistant

## Changes in this release

- First stable branded 1.x milestone for the PowerPlay companion integration.
- Introduces a custom cyan-and-blue PowerLink glyph, application tile, wordmark, and light/dark Home Assistant branding.
- Refreshes README, HACS artwork, and visual design guidance while retaining existing PowerShuffle, queue transfer, pairing and device policies.
- Designed for PowerPlay 2.0.0; existing compatible clients continue using the same integration domain and network protocol.

## Compatibility and notes

- Home Assistant integration domain remains `powerlink`.
- Existing device registrations, tokens, automations and entity identities are retained.
- This is an unpublished release candidate until explicitly approved.
